panels.scene: Sam at his desk far away, phone to his ear, a wall calendar behind him, relaxed and curious. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: Anything interesting in the mail this week?

panels.scene: June at her sunny kitchen table with a neat stack of envelopes, a letter opener and a mug, phone beside her, the small green kettle on the stove behind her. Capable and unhurried.
dialogue: A stack. I am sorting it.

panels.scene: June at her kitchen table smiling, one hand on the neat stack of envelopes, phone at her ear, mug beside her, the small green kettle on the stove.
dialogue: I will say if I want a hand.
panels.caption: She had it handled.
